mapper.select: select * from inspect_task_target_relation where task_id = #{taskId} group by target_id ORDER BY CONVERT(target_name USING gbk)
mapper.sql: select * from inspect_task_target_relation where task_id = #{taskId} group by target_id ORDER BY target_name
mapper.select: select DISTINCT ittr.plan_id, ittr.task_id, ittr.target_id from inspect_task_target_relation ittr left join inspect_task_target_item itti on (itti.task_id = ittr.task_id and itti.target_id = ittr.target_id) where ittr.create_time >= '2024-04-03 00:00:00' and itti.id is null limit 10000
